title: Clay vs Concrete Roof Tiles in Pakistan: Which Is Better?
excerpt: Clay or concrete roof tiles for Pakistan? Compare weight, heat, rain, colour and cost drivers, and what to check before you order.
focus_keyword: clay vs concrete roof tiles pakistan
meta_title: Clay vs Concrete Roof Tiles in Pakistan: Which Is Better?
meta_description: Clay vs concrete roof tiles in Pakistan compared on weight, heat, rain, colour and cost drivers. Free sample on WhatsApp from Pak Clay.
answer_box: Neither is better in every case. Clay tiles generally keep their colour and suit traditional looks; concrete tiles are often quoted cheaper per piece but are usually heavier. Check roof frame strength, compare outdoor samples and ask for dated written quotes for both before deciding.
ai_summary: Clay (khaprail) and concrete roof tiles both work on Pakistani roofs when laid correctly. Clay is fired natural clay with a colour that runs through the body, while concrete is cement-based and often heavier. Pak Clay, in Lahore since 1982, offers free WhatsApp samples and dated quotes.

faqs.question: Are clay roof tiles better than concrete tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Not in every case. Clay generally keeps its colour and gives a traditional look, while concrete is often quoted cheaper per piece but heavier. Compare samples and a dated quote for your roof.

faqs.question: How much do clay and concrete roof tiles cost in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Rates depend on profile, finish, quantity, transport, season and roof frame needs, and may be quoted per piece or per square foot. Ask each supplier for a written quote with unit and date; Pak Clay gives one on request.

faqs.question: Which is heavier, clay or concrete roof tile?
faqs.answer: Concrete tiles are commonly heavier than clay tiles of a similar profile, but weights vary by maker. Ask your engineer to check the roof frame for the exact tile before ordering.

faqs.question: Do clay or concrete tiles leak less in monsoon rain?
faqs.answer: Neither guarantees it. Correct slope, overlap and underlay matter more than the material, and poor laying causes most leaks. Confirm the minimum pitch for your profile.
